items.title: Pre-Purchased Additional Baggage
items.text: Purchase additional baggage online **before your flight** and enjoy **lower rates** than airport prices. Choose from flexible baggage options ranging from 5 kg to 25 kg and add them during booking or through My Booking.

items.title: Group Bookings
items.text: Travelling with **10 or more people?** Whether it's a family holiday, school trip, sports team, corporate event, or special occasion, we offer flexible booking options and dedicated support to make group travel simple.
